# ModelRig / Kaliv

> ModelRig is a local-first, model-agnostic control plane for persistent embodied AI. Kaliv is the first concrete person built on it.

Canonical site: https://kaliv.dk/
Languages: Danish and English
Public status: Not yet qualified for V1. All four public proof gates remain open.
Latest public release: Kaliv / ModelRig v2.0.15, published 2026-10-15.
Latest physical proof: interactive ModelRig-to-KalivHub-Receiver-to-Google Nest Hub 2 chain with visible state, real model response and active multi-turn session memory.

## Core thesis

ModelRig keeps identity, persistent state, memory, perception and action authority outside the language model. ThoughtEngine is replaceable cognition: it can propose, but it does not own the person or permission to act. Tool access and persistent writes pass through explicit, fail-closed control.

Kaliv is designed as one continuous identity across Windows, Android, KalivHub and Quest, with voice, body, memory and behavior connected through the same control plane.

## V1 qualification

V1 is defined by four proofs, not by a date:

1. Controlled Consciousness Core activation.
2. Physical perception through the complete VisionRig to WorldState chain.
3. One persistent person across Windows, Android, KalivHub and Quest.
4. Operational proof covering latency, soak testing and exact-head release controls.

## Terminology

- ModelRig: the infrastructure and control plane.
- Kaliv: the embodied person and product experience.
- KalivHub: the private home-orchestration layer and ambient product surface.
- KalivHub-Receiver: the public Cast receiver and visible home-interface boundary.
- Consciousness Core: authority for SelfState, WorldState, time, attention and continuity.
- Memory 4: documented autobiographical recall.
- ThoughtEngine: replaceable cognitive proposal layer.
- Agent 3: policy-approved execution.
